lesson.title: Word Forms Mastery: Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives & Adverbs

modules.name: Learn
modules.title: Word Forms Lessons
modules.instructions: Master verb, noun, adjective, and adverb forms of English words. Understand how suffixes transform word classes and when to use each form correctly.

modules.name: Write
modules.title: Writing Practice
modules.instructions: Write sentences using all four word forms (verb/noun/adjective/adverb) of target words. Apply word form rules in descriptive and analytical contexts.

modules.name: Play
modules.title: Word Form Games
modules.instructions: Play games to practice identifying word forms, choosing correct suffixes, and transforming words across grammatical categories.

modules.name: Apply
modules.title: Word Forms Challenge
modules.instructions: Apply suffix rules (-able, -ment, -ly, -tion) correctly. Master spelling changes when transforming words between forms.

categories.title: Sentence Starters / Useful Phrases
